# omtrdc.net
> OMTRDC provides online resources and information related to the Oklahoma Medical and Technical Research Development Center.

This site appears to center on organizational information, programs, resources, and public-facing updates relevant to OMTRDC activities and services.

## Main
- [Home](https://omtrdc.net/): Main entry point for OMTRDC information, announcements, and navigation.
- [About](https://omtrdc.net/about/): Overview of the organization, mission, and institutional background.
- [Contact](https://omtrdc.net/contact/): Contact details and inquiry information for reaching OMTRDC.
- [News](https://omtrdc.net/news/): Public updates, announcements, and recent organizational developments.

## Organization
- [Leadership](https://omtrdc.net/about/leadership/): Information about organizational leadership and key decision makers.
- [Mission](https://omtrdc.net/about/mission/): Summary of OMTRDC goals, purpose, and strategic direction.
- [History](https://omtrdc.net/about/history/): Background on the organization’s development and milestones.
- [Partners](https://omtrdc.net/about/partners/): Information about collaborating institutions and partner organizations.

## Programs
- [Programs Overview](https://omtrdc.net/programs/): Central listing of OMTRDC programs, initiatives, and service areas.
- [Research Support](https://omtrdc.net/programs/research-support/): Resources and assistance for research development and project support.
- [Training](https://omtrdc.net/programs/training/): Educational and professional development opportunities offered by OMTRDC.
- [Community Outreach](https://omtrdc.net/programs/community-outreach/): Public engagement and outreach initiatives supported by the organization.

## Resources
- [Resources](https://omtrdc.net/resources/): General collection of downloadable materials and reference information.
- [Publications](https://omtrdc.net/resources/publications/): Reports, papers, and other published materials from OMTRDC.
- [Forms](https://omtrdc.net/resources/forms/): Administrative and program-related forms for participants and partners.
- [Policies](https://omtrdc.net/resources/policies/): Organizational policies, procedures, and compliance-related documents.

## Research
- [Research](https://omtrdc.net/research/): Overview of research focus areas, projects, and institutional priorities.
- [Projects](https://omtrdc.net/research/projects/): Information about active and past research projects.
- [Funding Opportunities](https://omtrdc.net/research/funding/): Available grants, funding programs, and application-related information.
- [Collaborations](https://omtrdc.net/research/collaborations/): Research partnerships and collaborative initiatives across institutions.

## Events
- [Events](https://omtrdc.net/events/): Calendar of upcoming events, workshops, and public programs.
- [Workshops](https://omtrdc.net/events/workshops/): Training sessions and workshops hosted or supported by OMTRDC.
- [Conferences](https://omtrdc.net/events/conferences/): Conference participation, hosted meetings, and related event details.
- [Webinars](https://omtrdc.net/events/webinars/): Online seminars and virtual learning opportunities.

## News and Updates
- [Latest News](https://omtrdc.net/news/): Recent announcements, updates, and organizational news items.
- [Press Releases](https://omtrdc.net/news/press-releases/): Official statements and media-facing announcements.
- [Blog](https://omtrdc.net/blog/): Articles, commentary, and informational posts from the organization.
- [Archive](https://omtrdc.net/news/archive/): Historical collection of prior news and update posts.

## Support
- [Get Involved](https://omtrdc.net/get-involved/): Opportunities for participation, collaboration, and community engagement.
- [Donate](https://omtrdc.net/donate/): Information for supporters interested in contributing financially.
- [Volunteer](https://omtrdc.net/volunteer/): Volunteer opportunities and participation details.
- [Careers](https://omtrdc.net/careers/): Employment opportunities and organizational hiring information.
